name: Enable Eventstream as a CopyJob source and destination
description: Eventstream can now act as both a source and a destination within Fabric CopyJob, starting in the CopyJob authoring experience. This unifies batch and streaming movement so teams can connect continuous event data with the broad set of stores CopyJob supports.With this capability, you can:- Send streaming events from Eventstream into any CopyJob destination.- Bring data from CopyJob sources into Eventstream for real-time processing.- Build hybrid pipelines that combine batch and streaming data without custom integration.
